findings.entity: gold coin held against the front cup by the near hand
findings.description: From about 00:04.50 to 00:05.75 the coin under the near index fingertip sits flush inside the outline of the cup's outer wall, as if printed on or sunk into the steel. You never see a coin edge standing off the curved wall, and the finger seems to press the coin into the cup rather than hold it against the surface. Rim contact itself looks fine. The coin seems to merge with or pass into the cup wall.
